in_marathi.name: Manjeet
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Jewel, Precious One
in_marathi.long_meaning: Manjeet हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Manjeet is derived from the Sanskrit words 'mani' meaning jewel and 'jeet' meaning victory or conqueror. This name is often given to a child born during a time of prosperity and good fortune.
